instruction: View logrotate help page
output: logrotate --help

instruction: Create a basic logrotate config for custom logs
output:
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/custom << 'EOF'
/var/log/custom/*.log {
    daily
    rotate 14
    compress
    missingok
    notifempty
}
EOF

instruction: Add logrotate config for systemd journal
output:
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/systemd-journal << 'EOF'
/var/log/journal/*.journal {
    daily
    rotate 7
    compress
    missingok
}
EOF

instruction: Create logrotate config with size-based rotation
output:
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/size-based << 'EOF'
/var/log/app/app.log {
    size 100M
    rotate 5
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
}
EOF

instruction: Create logrotate config for json logs
output:
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/json-logs << 'EOF'
/var/log/app/*.json {
    daily
    rotate 10
    compress
    dateext
    missingok
}
EOF

instruction: Create logrotate config with sharedscripts
output:
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/shared << 'EOF'
/var/log/app1/*.log /var/log/app2/*.log {
    daily
    rotate 7
    sharedscripts
    postrotate
        systemctl reload app
    endscript
}
EOF

instruction: Add weekly rotation for auth.log
output:
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/auth-weekly << 'EOF'
/var/log/auth.log {
    weekly
    rotate 4
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
}
EOF

instruction: Create config that rotates every hour
output:
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/hourly-custom << 'EOF'
/var/log/quick/*.log {
    hourly
    rotate 24
    compress
    missingok
}
EOF

instruction: Add monthly rotation for old logs
output:
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/monthly-archive << 'EOF'
/var/log/archive/*.log {
    monthly
    rotate 12
    compress
    dateext
    missingok
}
EOF

instruction: Create config with both size and age
output:
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/size-age << 'EOF'
/var/log/mixed/*.log {
    size 50M
    maxage 30
    rotate 10
    compress
    missingok
}
EOF

instruction: Add olddir directory for rotated files
output:
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/olddir-example << 'EOF'
/var/log/app/*.log {
    daily
    rotate 5
    olddir /var/log/app/old
    compress
    missingok
}
EOF

instruction: Create config with firstaction/lastaction
output:
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/first-last << 'EOF'
/var/log/batch/*.log {
    daily
    rotate 7
    firstaction
        echo 'Starting rotation batch'
    endscript
    lastaction
        echo 'Finished rotation batch'
    endscript
}
EOF

instruction: Set create mode with specific ownership
output:
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/create-owned << 'EOF'
/var/log/app/*.log {
    daily
    rotate 7
    create 0640 www-data www-data
    compress
    missingok
}
EOF

instruction: Create logrotate config for multiple paths
output:
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/multi-path << 'EOF'
/var/log/service/*.log /var/log/service/*.err {
    weekly
    rotate 4
    compress
    missingok
    notifempty
}
EOF

instruction: Use full path spec with no wildcard
output:
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/exact-path << 'EOF'
/var/log/specific/app.log {
    daily
    rotate 3
    compress
    missingok
}
EOF

instruction: Add tabooext to exclude certain extensions
output:
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/taboo-ext << 'EOF'
/var/log/mixed/*.log {
    daily
    rotate 7
    tabooext + .tmp .swp
    compress
    missingok
}
EOF

instruction: Create logrotate config with dateformat
output:
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/date-format << 'EOF'
/var/log/app/*.log {
    daily
    rotate 30
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d-%s
    compress
    missingok
}
EOF

instruction: Set su directive to drop privileges
output:
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/su-directive << 'EOF'
/var/log/restricted/*.log {
    daily
    rotate 7
    su www-data www-data
    compress
    missingok
}
EOF

instruction: Create logrotate config for docker containers
output:
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/docker-logs << 'EOF'
/var/lib/docker/containers/*/*.log {
    rotate 3
    size 10M
    copytruncate
    compress
    missingok
}
EOF

instruction: Add postrotate to restart service
output:
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/restart-post << 'EOF'
/var/log/service/*.log {
    daily
    rotate 7
    postrotate
        systemctl restart service
    endscript
}
EOF
